title: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 6.5%
summaryWhatHappened: The Reserve Bank of India has maintained the status quo on interest rates for the 8th consecutive time.
summaryWhoImpacted: Home loan borrowers and deposit holders.
summaryActionableTakeaway: Continue with current EMI plans, FD rates are likely to remain stable.
summaryText: The Monetary Policy Committee decided to keep the repo rate unchanged...

title: New Tax Rules for Mutual Funds starting July

summaryActionableTakeaway: Consult your CA to rebalance your portfolio.
